ABOUT FIXMATE

Making home services easier for everyone.

FixMate is a home service platform designed to connect customers with technicians. Our goal is to make finding and booking everyday home services simple and convenient.

WHO WE ARE

Your home service, simplified.

Finding a reliable technician for home repairs can be challenging. FixMate aims to simplify that experience through a single platform where customers can discover available services and submit booking requests.

We also provide technicians with an opportunity to showcase their services and connect with customers who need their skills.
